confirmed_facts.fact: The parent task has completed before the child JVM is launched.
confirmed_facts.details: finish(t) is called before ProcessBuilder.start(); finish asserts the parent task status equals completed.

confirmed_facts.fact: The unchanged 30-second projection wait includes child Spring/JVM startup.
confirmed_facts.details: The deadline uses System.nanoTime immediately after ProcessBuilder.start; the loop checks process liveness and projection count. The assertion at line211 fails before memory.list or success process.json is written.

confirmed_facts.fact: The captured child connected to PostgreSQL but had not logged Spring startup completion.

details.timestamp_limit: These are wall-clock log timestamps; they do not establish a measured monotonic startup duration or the cause of delay.

confirmed_facts.fact: The child entrypoint explicitly configures memory components and does not component-scan the business application.
confirmed_facts.details: Imports are MapperConfiguration.Memory, AgentScopeMemoryModels, MyBatisMemoryRepository and MyBatisEmbeddingProfiles; its processor/poller are MemoryProcessingService based. No MemoryWorkerConfiguration class exists under src/main/java.

confirmed_facts.fact: Memory and release mappers have separate explicit registration.
confirmed_facts.details: Only MemoryMapper is registered by the imported Memory configuration. ReleaseMapper, including the new aggregate release lookup, is registered by the separate Releases configuration, absent from child imports.

confirmed_facts.fact: MemoryConfiguration does not import or construct ReleaseService.
confirmed_facts.details: It imports forget ledger/profile documents/event hub and constructs memory/forget/profile policy services; it is not part of the child explicit imports.

confirmed_facts.fact: The six reviewed memory entrypoint/test/config/processing sources are byte-identical to the pushed f330 baseline.
The failed test is an assertion failure, not a reported test error.
confirmed_facts.details: MemoryIT reports 26 cases, 1 failure, 0 errors, 0 skipped. The failing test elapsed38.103s includes work before/after the 30s wait and therefore is not itself the deadline duration.

confirmed_facts.fact: The surrounding full log shows successful current M4 database connection, distinct from old-pool warnings.
confirmed_facts.details: Current parent M4 uses HikariPool-36 and localhost:56818/m4 and logs Added connection plus successful schema9 validation. Connection-refused warnings interleaved from HikariPool8/11/12/15 use other old ports; the child log uses Pool1 and also logs Added connection. Those warnings do not establish this child could not reach its current database.

assessment.observed_failure_boundary: No projection before the fixed assertion deadline while the child startup-complete message is absent in the captured log.
assessment.relation_to_release_change: No direct release lookup invocation or new release-mapper assembly was found in the reviewed child entrypoint and memory processing chain. The changed release resolution on the parent task path did not prevent finish(t) from completing before launch.
assessment.static_review_limit: This is source/import and captured-log review, not child bean-graph introspection, process profiling or proof that a shared JAR can have no indirect timing effect.
not_established: A release-query regression causing the child failure
A definitive infrastructure-only or flaky-test classification
An HTTP embedding request failure or complete absence of HTTP requests; the captured startup log does not establish request activity

recommended_validation.if_failure_repeats: Preserve child startup/HTTP/model/DB timing evidence and investigate before changing the test or attributing a cause.

limits: SQL comparison alone does not certify a successful Maven process, complete test reports or unchanged source inputs.
Whole-turn scheduler families are separately reported; their timing-dependent difference is not attributed to individual owners or presented as lookup improvement.
Whole-turn global order and transaction boundary counts are reported, not required to match across concurrent runs.
Exact nonrelease ordered templates and commit/rollback counts are required only for the 14 bounded budget windows.
No throughput, production capacity, network round-trip, or improvement-percentage claim is inferred.
